strings.en: Hmph, so you've come before me.
I don't intend to waste time on this.
So you noticed me...!
Your response was slow.
I'll eliminate you.
I'll make the first move...!
I'll take out the nearest enemy first...!
Just a little more and victory is ours!
You won't get past here, Steel Dragons!
We have the Rabulpaila here!/　You have no chance of winning!
Here they come. Prepare to attack!
Shoot down the enemy units ahead!
The base's defenses are weakened./　Don't miss this chance.
Switch to counterattack!
Return fire!
Sieg Altolied.../　You disgrace to Gadisword!
For a traitor, there is only death!
Gadisword has no need for a man like you!
Die here along with Sieg!
People of Anex just can't be trusted!
I hope you're prepared, Sally Emil!
Hmph, you move like an amateur.
An Earthling new model...!
Your movements are sloppy here and there.
You may have gotten a bit faster.../　but you're still an easy target!
So you've added wings. So what?!
Fairy!/　You know the crime you've committed, don't you?!
Fairy Klibia... You traitor!
Selling your soul to the Earthlings.../　Have you no shame?!
I'll finish you off along with Fairy Klibia!
Never thought we'd catch their mothership so easily.
Sink the mothership and they'll panic!
It's a big target. Don't miss!
There's one thing to aim for... their core unit!
A Grungust type? Perfect prey!
So what if you shore it up with external modules!
A new Hückebein model? I'll take you on!
Hmph, what a shabby machine.
So what if you reinforced the frame!
A Gespenst type? Please!
It's just an old model anyway!
You misread the situation.
Where do you think you're going?
You're still within our range...!
As if I'd let you go!
You should've pulled out right away...!
I won't let that opening slip by!
Still hanging around there, I see!
Now it's my turn!
Damn it, is this the end?!
Ngh, what a disgraceful showing...!
To the Rabulpaila... back to Lady Reggiane...!!
Impossible, with so few forces...!
Nngh! I don't intend to die out in the sticks!
Ngh! You call this a real fight?!
Damn, it's stronger than expected...!
Nngh... We are not allowed to lose...!
The Ariard has to be here!/　Hold out no matter what!
Fairy, you of all people!
Curse you, Sieg!
Traitors will be punished without fail...!
That new model is surprisingly formidable...!
Damn that Grungust, it's good!
Ngh! I'll wipe you out!
Th-That strength... It truly is the Dragous...!
Ngh! Its speed and firepower are on another level!
Moving like that with such a huge body!
What's with its movements?!/　How is the pilot handling it?!
Nngh, the Double G... Not to be underestimated...!
That won't stop me!
Hmph, that was nothing.
Even counting that hit, the mission can proceed.
Oh... So you have some spirit.
Tch, a direct hit! But I can recover!
Damn, it's my equal...!
Ngh! Not bad!
I hate to admit it, but this one's no pushover...!
I'll give you credit for the nerve to take on this ship.
That woman! She truly is unforgivable!
Don't get cocky, Sieg!
Falling behind a traitor...!
Tch, I can't shake off the Grungust!
Beaten this badly by a dead copy!
That pilot.../　I can't sense any of the old hesitation...!
Ngh! Bold, ignoring how fragile that armor is!
Tch, first I must destroy that weapon module!
So the plan is to overwhelm us with that firepower...!
Damn that Double G, it outperforms the data...!
Hmph, so you landed a hit.
Covering fire? Pointless.
What are you playing at?
What, is that all?
Such a petty trick...
With that little power...
That won't even slow me down.
An attack with nothing worth noting.
Hmph, so you made it through the barrage.
You'll defy us to the end, Fairy?
Do you see the gap in skill now, Sieg?
Hmph, you thought to betray us with skills like that?
You're below the data, Grungust.
Just a cheap version after all.
That's the latest model? Laughable.
Only its looks were upgraded?
It can't balance mobility and power.
Is that weapon module just for show?
You're not making use of all that weaponry!
Is the Double G all intimidating looks?
Hmph, small fry.
Not even worth my time.
How transparent...
Hmph, I'd already ordered evasive maneuvers.
That's all the Anexians amount to anyway.
So what if a traitor sides with the Earthlings...!
That's not even an obstacle.
Useless!
And what of it?
Think up a better plan.
As if I'd fight without a plan.
You only wore yourself out for nothing.
You dared challenge me with skills like that?
How careless of me...
Tch, I can't counterattack like this!
Ngh, they played me!
Where did it disappear to...?!
Seems they know how to fight...!
Tch, losing sight of the target...!
It's not over yet!
You noticed us too late!
Lady Reggiane, I'll support you!
I'll handle the rest. You stay back.
No wonder you botched it like that.
That woman has no sense of urgency...!
I won't let you!
I won't let you lay a finger on Lady Reggiane!
Might as well have Golaikunru owe me one.
As expected, nowhere near Lady Reggiane.
Hmph, slow to react.
Battle is always about reading ahead!
Take this!
You're mine!
There!
Go down!
At this range!
Take this!
Take this!
I'll cut you down!
There...!
Got you!
I won't miss!
You're mine!
Lay down a barrage!
Fire a missile salvo!
Finish them with missiles!
Main Cannon, fire!
Main cannon, fire!
You won't escape!
If you want to run, then run...!
Not that it'll do any good!
It's over!
Be gone!
The outcome is clear!
Get blown away!
This will finish it!
With the Gyanonia's mobility!
Get blown away!
Barrel open!
Melt away!!
I'll overwhelm you with this thing's power!
You can't withstand this!!
